digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler repair and pause ownership
propositions: Repair surfaces must acquire and hold durable pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate before any destructive mutation, replacing GitHub-only gh workflow disable/enable safety.
Missing or misconfigured git user.email must abort repair before any pause write or mutation with a clear error message.
Pre-existing pause from another actor must be detected and abort repair without clearing the foreign pause.
Pause and OID must be read as a single snapshot during cleanup; clearing must compare the pause reason to the invocation token and use the observed OID for CAS deletion.
A held, corrupt, or uncertain reconciler lock check must abort repair; lock uncertainty leaves the pause owned for explicit operator recovery.
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair must use the same provider-neutral pause ownership contract without requiring a gh binary or changing their public vocabulary and non-repair behavior.
